notes.title: Welcome to Beast Siege – Chaos, Physics, and Colossal Bosses!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone — and welcome to the official [b]Beast Siege[/b] community!

We’re [b]Lumidia Games[/b], a small team building something big (literally).
[b]Beast Siege[/b] is an online co-op action RPG where up to 8 players team up to battle massive, fully physics-driven beasts.

In a world without magic, warriors rely on [b]gunpowder-powered tools[/b] to launch themselves into the air, pierce monsters with harpoons, and pull off explosive hammer strikes.
[b]Climb the beast. Smash its head. Trap its legs. Work together or get flung into the sky.[/b]

🧠 No scripted animations — just pure physics.
Every hit, swing, and stumble is a real-time reaction. If you land a blow on its cheek, you'll see its head snap just like it should.

⚔️ Our full gameplay trailer is coming soon, but we’ll be sharing sneak peeks and updates right here along the way.

Got questions, ideas, or wild Beast concepts? Drop them in the comments — we’re always listening (and so are the Beasts 👀)

👉 [b]Wishlist and follow[/b] if you’d like to join the siege when it begins!

See you in the battlefield,

— The Beast Siege Team
